name: Centpropazine
summary: Centpropazine (CPZ, CTZ) is an experimental antidepressant of the phenylpiperazine family which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder in India but was never marketed. It is described as having imipramine-like clinical effects, reversing reserpine-induced effects in animals, and potentiating amphetamine-induced effects in animals. The mechanism of action of centpropazine is unknown.

uses.text: Centpropazine (CPZ, CTZ) is an experimental antidepressant of the phenylpiperazine family which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder in India but was never marketed. The drug reached phase 3 clinical trials prior to the discontinuation of its development.

fact.en: The "cent" at the start of its name marks drugs from India's Central Drug Research Institute in Lucknow, which also produced the birth control pill centchroman.
fact.zh: 名稱開頭的「cent」代表它出自印度勒克瑙的中央藥物研究所，該所也研發了避孕藥 centchroman。
